source.title: Historical map of Rus', 862
source.author: N. N. Tornau
source.legendEvidence: The same pinned Tornau legend used by the verified 912, 972 and 1015 bases explicitly identifies the next cumulative acquisition layer as Yaroslav +1054.

expectedCoverageImpact.rule: Do not extend beyond a later independently supported territorial transition. No validity end is asserted by this candidate record.

acceptanceGates: Trace only the explicitly labelled Yaroslav +1054 acquisition layer from the hash-pinned same-sheet raster.
Use same-sheet georeferencing with explicit GCPs and no cross-sheet geometry transfer.
Keep the reconstruction low-confidence with uncertainty large enough to dominate manual edge reading and atlas distortion.
Exclude later principality divisions, temporary control and any layer not explicitly part of the cumulative 1054 state.
Require generated geometry, raster hash verification, spatial-control checks, strict History Core audit and green CI before promotion to geometry-verified.
Do not create or extend a verified base state from this research candidate alone.
note: This record closes an ambiguity in the next-base-state work queue: after the verified Vladimir +1015 state ends at 1053-12, the next same-sheet cumulative layer to trace is Yaroslav +1054. It intentionally carries no production geometry and therefore does not change verified-month counts.
